description: Original and constructed contrastive cases for Schema v3 regression. These examples are test data, not corpus-frequency evidence.

cases.actual_realization: process realized verbally in an ordinary clause
cases.congruent_agnate: 年轻人选择躺平。
positive_evidence: 躺平 functions as the Process in the clause
counter_evidence: zero derivation alone could invite a nominal reading elsewhere

cases.sentence: 年轻人的躺平引发了讨论。
cases.actual_realization: process meaning realized as nominal-group Head and participant
cases.congruent_agnate: 年轻人选择躺平，这引发了讨论。
positive_evidence: 躺平 is possessed and functions as the participant that causes discussion
counter_evidence: Chinese has no obligatory derivational nominalizer

cases.sentence: 看到结局，我瞬间破防了。
cases.actual_realization: colloquial Process in a finite clause
cases.congruent_agnate: 看到结局，我瞬间情绪失控了。
positive_evidence: 破防 is used as a Process rather than a Thing
counter_evidence: its figurative military imagery is lexical metaphor

cases.sentence: 网友的集体破防成为传播热点。
cases.actual_realization: process configuration realized as a nominal participant
cases.congruent_agnate: 网友集体破防，这成为传播热点。
positive_evidence: 集体破防 is the Token in a relational clause while retaining event meaning
counter_evidence: 破防 also has lexical-metaphorical history

cases.sentence: 人口迅速增长，资源压力随之上升。
cases.actual_realization: Process realized in a clause
cases.congruent_agnate: 人口迅速增长，资源压力随之上升。
positive_evidence: 增长 carries aspectual and circumstantial potential as the Process
counter_evidence: the same form can head a nominal group in another context

cases.sentence: 人口的迅速增长带来了资源压力。
cases.actual_realization: figure realized as a nominal group participant
cases.congruent_agnate: 人口迅速增长，因而资源压力上升。
positive_evidence: the complete growth figure is packaged as Actor of 带来
counter_evidence: 的 is not itself a nominalization marker

cases.actual_realization: material Process in a clause
cases.congruent_agnate: 学生走进教室。
positive_evidence: 走进 realizes the event congruently as Process
counter_evidence: none of the clause is packaged as a lower-rank Thing

cases.actual_realization: arrival process realized as possessed nominal participant
cases.congruent_agnate: 他到来了，这改变了局面。
positive_evidence: 到来 retains event meaning but functions as Actor
counter_evidence: Chinese word class is not overtly marked

cases.actual_realization: ordinary entity realized as nominal group
cases.congruent_agnate: 桌子很大。
positive_evidence: 桌子 denotes an entity and is realized nominally
counter_evidence: nominal realization alone is not GM

cases.actual_realization: Process realized by a finite verb
cases.congruent_agnate: The committee rejected the proposal.
positive_evidence: rejected realizes the event as Process
counter_evidence: a nominal agnate exists but is not selected here

cases.sentence: The committee's rejection of the proposal caused concern.
cases.actual_realization: process realized as nominal-group Head
cases.congruent_agnate: The committee rejected the proposal, so people became concerned.
positive_evidence: rejection retains the rejecting event and accepts possessive and of-participant structure
counter_evidence: rejection can be lexicalized in some institutional uses

cases.sentence: The experiment failed because the seal broke.
cases.actual_realization: causal relation realized by conjunction between clauses
cases.congruent_agnate: The experiment failed because the seal broke.
positive_evidence: because congruently links two figures
counter_evidence: the relation could be reconstrued as a Process in another wording

cases.sentence: The failure resulted from a broken seal.
cases.actual_realization: causal relation realized as Process
cases.congruent_agnate: The experiment failed because the seal broke.
positive_evidence: a causal link is construed as the Process resulted from
counter_evidence: result is an established lexical relation and the boundary can be register-sensitive

cases.actual_realization: quality realized as nominal participant
cases.congruent_agnate: She was kind to the child, and this reassured the child.
positive_evidence: the quality kind is packaged as the Actor kindness
counter_evidence: kindness is a conventional noun but the quality relation remains active

cases.sentence: She was kind to the child.
cases.actual_realization: quality realized as Attribute
cases.congruent_agnate: She was kind to the child.
positive_evidence: kind directly realizes a quality
counter_evidence: the agnate kindness would package the quality as a Thing

cases.sentence: The fact that the sample melted surprised us.
cases.actual_realization: finite embedded clause qualifying fact
cases.congruent_agnate: The sample melted, and that surprised us.
positive_evidence: the event remains realized by a finite clause
counter_evidence: the clause is embedded at group rank

cases.actual_realization: embedded WH clause functioning as participant
cases.congruent_agnate: He proposed something, and it was accepted.
positive_evidence: the proposal remains clausal in form
counter_evidence: participant function creates rank shift but not full reconstrual

cases.actual_realization: established classifier in the compound arrival time
positive_evidence: arrival classifies a scheduled time rather than asserting an event
counter_evidence: arrival is historically and morphologically related to arrive

cases.sentence: The city is a sleeping giant.
cases.actual_realization: figurative nominal description
cases.congruent_realization: the city has great inactive potential
cases.congruent_agnate: The city has great potential that is not yet active.
positive_evidence: giant metaphorically describes the city
counter_evidence: figurative wording is lexical, with no demonstrated cross-stratal remapping

cases.actual_realization: ordinary entity realized nominally
cases.congruent_agnate: The table is large.
positive_evidence: table denotes a Thing and is realized as a nominal group
counter_evidence: nounhood alone cannot establish GM

cases.actual_realization: command enacted by interrogative Mood in the supplied request context
cases.congruent_agnate: Close the window.
positive_evidence: expected response is compliance rather than ability information
counter_evidence: without the request context it can be a literal ability question
cases.context_before: Speaker asks a nearby addressee to remove a draft.

cases.actual_realization: conventional offer realized by modal interrogative
cases.congruent_agnate: Would you like some tea?
positive_evidence: expected response is acceptance or refusal of offered goods
counter_evidence: interrogative form can misleadingly be treated as an indirect command
cases.context_before: A host offers a guest a drink.

cases.actual_realization: command realized by imperative Mood
cases.congruent_agnate: Close the window.
positive_evidence: imperative Mood matches the demand for goods-and-services
counter_evidence: tone may alter politeness but not create a Mood mismatch by itself

cases.actual_realization: probability expanded through a projecting clause
cases.congruent_agnate: He will probably arrive.
positive_evidence: I think is read as subjective explicit probability rather than a report of cognition
counter_evidence: in another context think can be a literal Mental Process

cases.actual_realization: probability realized by modal Adjunct
cases.congruent_agnate: He will probably arrive.
positive_evidence: probably is an implicit subjective modal realization
counter_evidence: it has an expanded projecting-clause agnate

cases.sentence: I don't think he is coming.
cases.actual_realization: negative meaning transferred to the projecting clause
cases.congruent_agnate: I think he isn't coming.
positive_evidence: the disputed negative concerns his coming but is located on think
counter_evidence: literal denial of thinking is possible in a marked context

cases.actual_realization: negative realized directly in the projected clause
cases.congruent_agnate: I think he isn't coming.
positive_evidence: negative polarity is located with the proposition it negates
counter_evidence: a negative-transfer agnate exists

cases.actual_realization: command enacted by 能…吗 interrogative in request context
cases.congruent_agnate: 请把门关上。
positive_evidence: 回应潜势是执行或拒绝，而非报告能力
counter_evidence: 在能力测试语境中可作真实疑问
cases.context_before: 说话者请求听话者关门。

cases.actual_realization: command realized by imperative construction
cases.congruent_agnate: 请把门关上。
positive_evidence: 祈使形式与要求物品和服务的功能一致
counter_evidence: 请体现礼貌但不自动构成隐喻

cases.sentence: 我认为他可能已经到了。
cases.actual_realization: probability stance expanded as projecting clause
cases.congruent_agnate: 他可能已经到了。
positive_evidence: 我认为在此标示命题概率来源而非持续思考活动
counter_evidence: 认为在其他语境可作字面的心理过程

cases.actual_realization: probability realized inside the clause
cases.congruent_agnate: 他可能已经到了。
positive_evidence: 可能直接实现概率值
counter_evidence: 可扩展为我认为等显性主观实现

cases.actual_realization: isolated orthographic word
positive_evidence: 发展 can realize a Process or participate in a nominal group
counter_evidence: no clause selects a contextual meaning or grammatical function
candidate_interpretations: 名物化候选读法：某事物的发展

cases.actual_realization: isolated polysemous word
positive_evidence: bank has multiple entity and process senses
counter_evidence: no clause establishes the active sense or mapping

cases.sentence: The man who arrived yesterday waved.
cases.actual_realization: relative clause embedded as nominal-group qualifier
cases.congruent_agnate: The man arrived yesterday, and he waved.
positive_evidence: arrived remains a finite Process inside the relative clause
counter_evidence: the clause is rankshifted as a Qualifier

cases.actual_realization: deciding event realized as nominal participant
cases.congruent_agnate: Someone decided.
positive_evidence: decision packages deciding as a Thing and permits the agent to remain absent
counter_evidence: decision can denote an institutional product in other contexts

cases.actual_realization: deciding realized as finite Process
cases.congruent_agnate: They decided.
positive_evidence: decided realizes the event congruently and retains tense
counter_evidence: decision is a nominal agnate but is not selected

cases.actual_realization: established abstract entity without an expressed related figure
positive_evidence: reason refers anaphorically to an entity-like explanation
counter_evidence: reason can construe a logical relation when its figures are recoverable

cases.sentence: Rain caused the match to stop.
cases.actual_realization: causal relation realized as Process
cases.congruent_agnate: The match stopped because it rained.
positive_evidence: causal link between rain and stopping is construed as the Process caused
counter_evidence: cause is a conventional causal verb

cases.sentence: Because it rained, the match stopped.
cases.actual_realization: causal relation realized by conjunction
cases.congruent_agnate: Because it rained, the match stopped.
positive_evidence: Because links two clauses as a causal relation
counter_evidence: the relation can be metaphorically realized as cause

cases.actual_realization: quality realized as possessed nominal participant
cases.congruent_agnate: 她很美丽，所以令人难忘。
positive_evidence: 美丽 retains quality meaning while functioning as nominal participant
counter_evidence: 汉语形名之间没有强制形态标记

cases.actual_realization: quality realized predicatively
cases.congruent_agnate: 她很美丽。
positive_evidence: 美丽 directly realizes the attributed quality
counter_evidence: same form may enter a nominal group elsewhere

cases.actual_realization: 研究 may denote activity, findings, or an institutional source
positive_evidence: 研究 occupies Sayer position and can retain activity meaning
counter_evidence: it may refer to a report, findings, or institution rather than an active process
candidate_interpretations: 研究成果作为普通实体来源

cases.sentence: The condition for entry is that applicants pay in advance.
cases.actual_realization: conditional relation realized as nominal-group Head
cases.congruent_agnate: Applicants may enter if they pay in advance.
positive_evidence: condition packages the if relation as a definable Thing
counter_evidence: condition is a conventional noun and requires the related figures to remain recoverable
